parts.text: Mera naam Gourav hai aur main raat ko padhta hoon

Arrey Gourav! Kya baat hai! ✨

Toh tum night owl ho, raat ko padhna pasand karte ho! Acha hai yaar, raat ki shanti mein padhai ka apna hi maza hai. Ab se main yaad rakhungi Gourav night mein padhta hai! 😄
